items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Donald Byrd' is mentioned by the interviewer as a person they know or are addressing, but the interviewee (J.C. Higginbotham) does not mention Donald Byrd, nor is there any evidence of a personal or professional relationship between Higginbotham and Byrd in the text.

ctx.x: I'll have to do a whole lot of looking so you let me know by tomorrow. I don't listen to records. My wife she go in the back, and does. ... Sometimes 3 and 4 and 5 o'clock I hear music, pick there clappin her hands and well, she ... playing when the Saints Come Marching In, that's what she's listening to. And, I have quite a collection but I loan them out to people -- stupid. They break them. They Typical either say they forgot to bring them back. They story.
You're talking to someone who does that all the time. Donald Byrd.
